origin: procedura E00-R01 (docs/reports/2026-09-06-e00-r01.md), riprodotta bit per bit in E01-R01; costanti copiate da scripts/build_e00_notebooks.py

input_prep_aligned.z_pool: rounded mean of 4 centered source planes
